main_text.l: Ecclesiasticæ Historiæ, Linguarum Orientalium, Artiumque Logic. in Collegio Carolino Professore ordinario;
Pro consequendo Examine Philosophico alternatim sequentes ventilabunt Candidati.

page.notes: The title is set in mixed type; the year is printed as "1 6 5 4" with spaced figures, transcribed as 1654. The "Quam;" and "DEO Ter.Opt. Max.juvante" lines are as printed. Handwritten "15" at top right is not printed text and is omitted from the page number field only in the sense that it is manuscript; it is given as page_number.
